reviewer_scope: Independent read-only review of the Linux Java JSR305 snapshot candidate; no candidate or source edits.

pinned_source.assessment: The displayed package and declaration inventory correspond to the pinned JSR305 tree.

checks.packages: CLI package shelf exits 0 and reports the indexed project ready.

outline.assessment: The CLI and MCP summaries agree on declaration count and completeness; the 31 non-module roots correspond to the 31 Java source files.

search.assessment: Qualified source-backed hits match the pinned declarations and lines. Additional pathless, language=unknown hits are lexical name-lane results; they are distinct from the source-backed Java semantic records and are consistent with complete names coverage.

mcp.assessment: MCP search records carry the same qualified names, Java paths, lines, and ready state as CLI. Both searches correctly report more=true at limit 3; the runtime log says the offered continuation was consumed by a fresh MCP session. Snapshot cursor strings are sanitized placeholders and were not treated as identities.

cross_host_comparison: Native and Linux snapshots agree on declaration totals, qualified-name set, and source locations. Opaque coordinates and keys differ with the host's /tmp versus /private/tmp project path and were not required to match.
limitations: This reviews semantic correctness only; the 67.25-second add and other performance values are preliminary samples, not calibrated performance claims.
The diagnostic log explicitly records that this is not official T2 green; acceptance here applies only to the reviewed snapshot candidate.
reviewer: Codex / GPT-6 Luna, independent pinned-source/result review
calibration_status: Initial Linux sample only; repeat exact-head comparison/calibration required before merge. No existing baselines or bands changed.
